## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run test` and `bun run lint` pass
- [ ] I wrote this, or have the right to submit it, and my commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] I agree to the terms in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md): FSL-1.1-MIT, and the author may relicense my contribution
- [ ] New sounds are CC0 and listed in `public/sounds/CREDITS.md`; new dependencies are listed in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`
- [ ] It does not include the Focus/Space name or logo in a way that breaks `TRADEMARK.md`
